svg.title: The ADFGX Cipher
svg.desc: ATTACKATDAWN is looked up in a 5 by 5 square keyed with PLAYFAIR, turning each letter into two of the symbols A, D, F, G, X. The 24 symbols are written in rows under GERMANY, the columns are sorted alphabetically by key letter and read top to bottom, giving GGAFDXGAFGFXFXXAFGGDAAFX.
